Prevention: Remove stubble and weeds from field before planting and burn or compost.
Apply well decomposed farmyard manure and compost prior to planting and during growing period.

Rotate the crop with legumes every year.
Ploughing during late spring or early autumn destroys many larvae, pupae and adults in the soil and also exposes the insects to predators, such as birds and skunks.
For this cultural practice to be effective, ploughing must occur before the grubs migrate below the plough depth.
In the summer and prior to planting deep plough the field and leave soil exposed to the sun for a minimum of one week.
See yellow direct control for preventative insecticides.
Monitoring: Take soil (about 30x30x30 cm) from 3 random locations /ropani and look for white grubs.
Take action when you find a minimum of one white grub / ropani.
Direct Control: Metarhizium anisopliae 1.15 % WP, at 1 kg/ ropani.
Chlorpyriphos 1.5% DP dust, at 1kg /ropani, mixed into the soil
